decision: Selected the area centroid of the 'Geltungsbereich der 1. Änderung' outline of Bebauungsplan Nr. 25b 'Gewerbe- und Logistikzentrum Ostsee 3.0', traced from the Übersichtsplan annexed to the Gemeinde Dummerstorf notice of 14 October 2026 and registered to the BKG basemap.de web raster (EPSG:25833) with a seven-point affine fit, as the project locator. The notice says the planned large data centre would need almost the whole plan area; no building, substation or entrance is located.
source_map: Page 2 of the notice PDF: 'Anlage: Übersichtsplan - Geltungsbereich der 1. Änderung des Bebauungsplanes Nr. 25b', an extract of the official topographic map (© GeoBasis-DE/MV 2026) embedded as one 604 x 500 pixel JPEG (pdfimages, page 2, image 0). The thick dashed outline labelled 'Geltungsbereich der 1. Änderung' was traced; the separately labelled 'Geltungsbereich Ursprungsplan' (which also covers the access strip south to the L191) was not used.

reference_map.publisher: Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie (BKG) / basemap.de (Länder-Vermessungsverwaltungen)
reference_map.pixel_to_crs: E = 315500 + 2 u, N = 5991500 - 2 v (EPSG:25833; 2 m per pixel; u,v continuous pixel coordinates from the image's top-left corner)

control_points.feature: Kreuz Rostock: crossing of the A19 and A20 carriageway centrelines (notice map left edge)
Crossing of the L39 and the L191 north-east of the logistics buildings
Junction of the L191 with the Gewerbepark Ostsee access road (roundabout) west of Dummerstorf village
Crossing of the L191 over the A19 at the Kavelstorf junction
Roundabout on the L39 east of the logistics buildings
Crossing of the L39 over the A20 at the Dummerstorf junction
Crossing of the L191 over the A20

affine_fit.model: E = a x + b y + c; N = d x + e y + f (least squares, notice-map pixels to EPSG:25833 metres)

consistency_checks.original_plan_area_ha_stated: about 46.5 ha (Begründung zum B-Plan Nr. 25b, Satzungsbeschluss 1 February 2022, section 1.2), which also includes the southern access strip to the L191 that the 1. Änderung outline excludes
consistency_checks.overlay_check: Drawn on the basemap.de raster the registered outline lies in the open field south of the Liepgraben lowland and the Auf dem Lieper Berge woodland, west of the Gewerbepark Ostsee road (its south-east edge follows that road) and west of the existing logistics buildings of B-Plans 19/25a; the field track that crosses the plan area diagonally on the B-Plan 25b Planzeichnung crosses the registered outline in the same direction. The plan description (south of the A20, north-west of Dummerstorf village, bounded north-east and east by B-Plan 25a, north and west by the Liepgraben lowland, south by the L191 corridor) matches.

transform_check: Affine fit and outline centroid computed in EPSG:25833 with numpy least squares and shapely 2.1.1; centroid transformed to WGS84 (EPSG:4326, lon/lat) with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy).
uncertainty: No coordinates, grid or datum are printed on the Übersichtsplan; its embedded raster has about 5.4 m per pixel. Registration residuals (RMS 6.8 m, maximum 10.1 m, maximum leave-one-out error 38.2 m at the image-edge Kreuz Rostock point) measure map-to-reference consistency only; tracing the dashed outline adds roughly one to two pixels (about 5-11 m) per vertex. The point is the centroid of a 38.6 ha planning area whose vertices lie up to 474 m away; the data-centre buildings' positions are not published.
